title: Accountant
description:
**Company Description** 
 VVK \& Associates (Chartered Accountants) is a professional services firm dedicated to providing trusted financial expertise and strategic business solutions to organizations, entrepreneurs, and individuals. The firm offers comprehensive services across Taxation, GST compliance, Audit \& Assurance, Accounting, Financial Advisory, and Regulatory Compliance, with a strong emphasis on accuracy, integrity, and timely execution. VVK \& Associates supports clients in navigating complex financial and statutory requirements, helping them operate confidently within evolving regulatory frameworks. The firm is committed to building long\-term relationships through professionalism, transparency, and value\-driven advisory, ensuring that clients receive insightful guidance and practical support. Core services include direct and indirect taxation, GST registration and filing, statutory and internal audits, bookkeeping, business advisory, company law compliance, and financial planning.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Accountant role based in Ghaziabad with VVK \& Associates (Chartered Accountants). The Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate books of accounts, preparing financial statements, and handling day\-to\-day accounting entries in accordance with applicable standards. Typical tasks include managing accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, ledger scrutiny, and assisting in tax computations, GST returns, and other statutory filings. The role also involves supporting audit and assurance activities, preparing working papers, and coordinating with seniors to ensure timely completion of compliance and reporting requirements. The Accountant will collaborate with team members to streamline processes, respond to client queries, and contribute to the firm’s commitment to high\-quality, compliant financial practices.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Strong foundational knowledge of accounting principles, financial statements, and bookkeeping practices.
* Experience with tax\-related work such as basic direct and indirect tax computations, GST working, and support for filings.
* Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Tally , ZOHO or similar), MS Excel, and general office productivity tools.
* Attention to detail, strong numerical aptitude, and the ability to maintain accurate and organized financial records.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues and interact professionally with clients.
* Ability to manage deadlines, prioritize multiple tasks, and maintain confidentiality of financial information.
* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or a related field; pursuing or completed professional qualifications (e.g., CA Inter) will be an advantage.
* Prior internship or work experience in a CA firm or a similar professional services environment is preferred but not mandatory.
